page.layout: One column of running text, full width. In the right margin, beside the line "Laf-", one marginal reference note. Running head at top with the page number at top right.

main_text.p: A Domino itaque vocati & armati, ad magnum hoc prælium Dei Omnipotentis accedant necesse est: quapropter scrutetur unusquisque cor suum, an novitate aliquâ, vel peregrinandi libidine, vel tædio rerum præsentium motus, huc properet: ille enim animi status plane ineptus est & instabilis in hoc tam gravi negocio: ferucentem[?] zelum gloriæ divinæ, amorem Ecclesiæ, propriæ salutis & Felicitatis Spiritualis curam si huc adigere se senserit, tunc ne dubitet, an felix eventus se maneat; nec differat oblatam sibi Domini gratiam amplecti: est enim in hujusmodi, efficax & potens Spiritus præsentia, quæ eos extra vires suas posita, alacriter aggredi & fortiter exequi docet. Bellum enim hic Domini geritur, qui dat lasso fortitudinem, & cui non sunt vires robur multiplicat. Las-Esaj. 40. 29.santur in hoc stadio, adolescentes suis cōfi-si viribus, & juvenes quos humana ratio ob animosam commendat industriâ, gravi ruina cocidunt[?], at sperantes in Domino novum acquirét robur, ascendant alā sicut aquilæ; current & non lassabuntur, ambulabunt & non fatigabuntur, quia Dominus est fortitudo eorum, & in Deo suo transiliunt murum, nullumque est adversariorum munimentum, quod incursui illorum resistat. Spirituales enim illorum machinæ funt,

page.notes: Right margin: one reference note "Esaj. 40. 29." (printed as Efaj.), placed beside "Las-". The word "lassantur" is broken at the line end as "Las-" / "santur"; the hyphen is printed. Doubtful readings: "ferucentem" (could be feruentem), "cocidunt" (could be cecidunt), "alā" (the printed mark over the a is unclear). "cōfi-si" is read from the broken word "confisi". Ink blot on the right margin near the middle, not text. The catchword "funt," and the signature "B 5" are at the foot.
